posts.title: New website and features
posts.body:
As you can now see, the new COBRA website is up and running, with some hopefully interesting stats and features for you. 

Anyone who has not yet, please upload an image of your car to the [Driver Car Avatars Upload Page](https://racehub.cobracardiff.co.uk/avatar-upload/).

These are used in an increasing number of areas of the site, from Driver profile to virtial race replays and Poldium gallery.
